restrictions: Target: complete fixed-IV SHA-256 reduced to the first 40 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, all 256 output bits equal; ordinary two-block collision M0||M1 and M0||M1' with the same random first block M0 (no chaining-value difference); message difference is r39's support W8..W12 (Dariia's 40-step characteristic), expanded-schedule differences at 16, 17, 24, 26, 31, 33, 35, 37, 38, 39.
Prices: costs reported in target compressions at C = 2,896 ops per compression (DECLARED); claw and tail measured against the accepted r39 tools, same type and split as the accepted r39 entry.

Construction (r39 structure): (1) advice = Dariia's head pair (CV*, M1, M1') through row 30, 0 violations; (2) transplant onto a random M0's CV by the exact r39 bijection sraiw 38912d66, head rows inherited; (3) distinguished-point claw walk (darijoint.py) with survivors checked against every bit condition; (4) tail rows 18..39 paid probabilistically with wintail.py SMC carrier plus GPU wt2gpu.cu, hit = equal state after step 39.

Cost ledger: time_log2 = (28.89 - 11.50) + |log2 p_tail| - 1.02 = 15.37 + |log2 p_tail|; R40 = 15.37 (claw MEASURED) + 124.0 (tail rows 18-23 MEASURED) + 77 (rows 24-39 COUNT, H2b) = 216.4; claw MEASURED at 2^28.89 ops/survivor (46 of 677,878 distinct claws, 828 windows of 2^22); success term -1.02 for success 0.39.

Premises govern the score: H1-claw (claw independence, random window CVs, per-claw charge = r39 final-verify upper bound), H2-tail (tail transfers from the advice window), H3-advice (the advice pair is given), H2b-rows-24+ (rows 24-39 hold at 2^-77 given the carrier, declared).

Memory: the walk's table (r39 class, 2^20 bytes) plus one advice pair; the advice is a 160-byte class so nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes = log2(160) = 7.322; preprocessing is 2^0 (none beyond the given advice).

heuristics.statement: Claws behave independently (untested); window chaining values are random as in r39; the per-claw charge equals the r39 final-verify, which is an upper bound.

heuristics.extrapolation: the r39 per-claw charge and random-window premise applied to Dariia's advice pair
heuristics.limitations: claw walk measured on the advice pair (677,878 distinct claws, 46 survive row 17, 828 windows of 2^22); the per-claw charge is an upper bound; independence is declared

heuristics.statement: The tail on transplanted states equals the tail measured on the advice window (the r39 premise of the same name).
